title: A2/B1 Promotes NRF2 mRNA Stability and Inhibits Ferroptosis and Cell Proliferation in Breast Cancer Cells.
authors: Huang, Yan; Chen, Jingjing; Pan, Juan; Yang, Yifu; Huang, Hongwu; Lai, Huiping; Yang, Lei; Ai, Hongyan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究hnRNP A2/B1对NRF2 mRNA稳定性的调控及对乳腺癌细胞铁死亡和增殖的影响，虽涉及RNA结合蛋白与mRNA互作，但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且方法以实验为主，仅提及神经网络算法而无AI/物理模拟建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Breast cancer is a highly harmful malignant tumor, which poses a great threat to women's body and mind, and the mortality rate ranks second among all women's diseases. The incidence rate accounts for 7-10% of various malignant tumors in the whole body, second only to uterine cancer in women, and has become the main cause of threatening women's health. Advanced breast cancer is often considered an incurable disease. The family of heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein complexes is composed of about 20 hnRNP proteins with molecular weights ranging from 32 to 120 kDa, and they are named according to their molecular weights. Among them, hnRNPA2 and hnRNPB1 are the two most important members of the hnRNP family, both derived from the same gene on chromosome 7p15. Therefore, research to understand the molecular mechanism and process of breast cancer progression has an important role in promoting the current medical research on breast cancer treatment methods. Therefore, studying the mechanism of tumorigenesis is the key to tumor prevention and treatment. Therefore, this paper proposes that A2/B1 promotes the stability of NRF2 mRNA and inhibits ferroptosis and cell proliferation in breast cancer cells. The article mainly introduces the disease diagnosis method based on artificial neural network and its neural network algorithm. In the experimental part, the activity of hnRNP A2/B1 on cancer cells is deeply studied. The results show that the absorbance of the MTT method increases continuously with the extension of the culture time, and the maximum reaches 1.2. This fully shows that its absorption capacity is very strong, especially after 24 hours, the absorption rate rises from 0.6 to 0.9, which shows that 24 hours is the best absorption time. And it can also be found that hnRNPA2/B1 has a significant inhibitory effect on breast cancer cells; it can reduce the effect on breast cancer cell cycle and apoptosis.
abstract_zh: 乳腺癌是一种危害极大的恶性肿瘤，对女性身心健康构成巨大威胁，其死亡率在女性所有疾病中位居第二。其发病率占全身各类恶性肿瘤的7-10%，在女性中仅次于子宫癌，已成为威胁女性健康的主要原因。晚期乳腺癌常被视为不治之症。异质性核糖核蛋白复合物家族由约20种分子量在32至120 kDa之间的hnRNP蛋白组成，并根据其分子量命名。其中，hnRNPA2和hnRNPB1是hnRNP家族中两个最重要的成员，均源自染色体7p15上的同一基因。因此，研究了解乳腺癌进展的分子机制和过程，对当前医学界关于乳腺癌治疗方法的探索具有重要推动作用。因此，研究肿瘤发生的机制是肿瘤防治的关键。基于此，本文提出A2/B1通过促进NRF2 mRNA的稳定性，抑制乳腺癌细胞中的铁死亡和细胞增殖。文章主要介绍了基于人工神经网络的疾病诊断方法及其神经网络算法。在实验部分，深入研究了hnRNP A2/B1对癌细胞活性的影响。结果表明，MTT法的吸光度随培养时间的延长而持续增加，最大值达到1.2。这充分表明其吸收能力非常强，尤其是在24小时后，吸收率从0.6上升至0.9，显示24小时为最佳吸收时间。同时，还发现hnRNPA2/B1对乳腺癌细胞具有显著的抑制作用；它能减少对乳腺癌细胞周期和凋亡的影响。
